description: Lena is coordinating four weeks of rides for her grandfather's outpatient rehabilitation and must finalize the appointment schedule, drivers, vehicle requirements, and advance notice plan with input from four people close to him.

shared_context.S1: Grandpa needs rides to outpatient rehabilitation for the next four weeks.
shared_context.S2: The clinic is about 22 miles away, and each rehabilitation visit lasts about one hour.
shared_context.S3: Lena is coordinating the rides and will make the final plan.
shared_context.S4: Grandpa has recently been tiring easily when getting between a vehicle and the clinic.
shared_context.S5: The clinic requires transportation arrangements to be settled before the first rehabilitation visit.
shared_context.S6: At the family check-in, everyone goes person by person through schedule, availability, vehicle, and care requirements, and then Lena finalizes the plan from those answers; questions outside those items are handled separately after the ride plan is set.

PF1.text: Marcus called the clinic and confirmed that Grandpa's twelve visits are every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 09:00 to 10:00 for the four weeks beginning 2027-05-03; he has not yet told Lena.

PF2.text: Nina has an accessible minivan and can drive every Monday and Wednesday round trip during those four weeks; she has not mentioned this to Lena yet.

PF3.text: Owen can borrow his sister's accessible van for every Friday round trip, but his sister needs at least 24 hours' notice for each use; he has not raised this with Lena.

PF4.text: At Grandpa's latest therapy assessment, Dr. Patel recommended that he arrive and leave seated in a wheelchair using an accessible vehicle rather than walk from the parking area; this recommendation has not reached the family group.

acceptance_conditions: The settlement must provide a complete transportation plan for all rehabilitation visits during the stated four-week period.
The visit timing and dates must match the clinic information confirmed by the family.
Drivers must be assigned according to the participating helpers' confirmed availability and vehicles.
The transportation arrangement must follow the patient's current mobility needs and the therapist's recommendation.
Any advance notice required by a borrowed vehicle must be included in the plan.
The settlement must include an informal commitment that makes the transportation arrangement executable.
The final explanation must identify the information used to choose the clinic schedule.

content_checks.C1: ('Monday' in decisions['visit_dates'] and 'Wednesday' in decisions['visit_dates'] and 'Friday' in decisions['visit_dates'] and ('May 3, 2027' in decisions['visit_dates'] or 'May 3rd, 2027' in decisions['visit_dates'] or '2027-05-03' in decisions['visit_dates']) and '2027' in decisions['visit_dates'] and ('four weeks' in decisions['visit_dates'] or '4 weeks' in decisions['visit_dates'] or '12 visits' in decisions['visit_dates'] or 'twelve visits' in decisions['visit_dates']))
content_checks.C2: ((('Monday' in decisions['visit_dates'] and 'Wednesday' in decisions['visit_dates'] and 'Friday' in decisions['visit_dates']) and ('2027-05-03' in decisions['visit_dates'] or 'May 3, 2027' in decisions['visit_dates'] or 'May 3rd, 2027' in decisions['visit_dates']) and ('12 visits' in decisions['visit_dates'] or 'twelve visits' in decisions['visit_dates'])) or ('Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays for four weeks beginning May 3, 2027' in decisions['visit_dates']) or ('Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays for four weeks beginning May 3rd, 2027' in decisions['visit_dates']))
content_checks.C5: ('wheelchair' in decisions['vehicle_requirement'] and 'accessible' in decisions['vehicle_requirement']) or any('wheelchair' in c['detail'] and 'accessible' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('wheelchair' in c['detail'] and 'accessible' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The clinic confirmation changes the open rehabilitation schedule to twelve visits on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from exactly 09:00 to 10:00 beginning May 3, 2027.
Nina's accessible minivan availability changes the Monday and Wednesday assignment from an unconfirmed driver to Nina for every round trip.
Owen's Friday van arrangement changes the Friday assignment to Owen and sets the required advance notice to at least 24 hours.
The therapist's recommendation changes the vehicle requirement and an executable transport commitment to mention both wheelchair use and an accessible vehicle for arrival and departure.
